observations: Photo 0 shows a black console with a stepped, multi-vent body typical of a PS4 Pro shape, resting on a surface with cables behind it.
Two sealed retail boxes for Sony DualShock 4 (red color) wireless controllers are stacked on top of the console.
No loose controllers, no game discs/cases, no power cable, no HDMI cable, and no serial number plate are visible.

Two overlaid watermarks are visible on the image: 'POSTED ON...' and 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL', suggesting this image originates from another seller's or a stock catalogue listing rather than a photo taken by this seller.
No close-up of the console's rear ports, top surface wear, or Sony model/serial sticker is shown.

identity.kind: PS4 Pro game console with two boxed wireless controllers

risks.proof: A fresh, unedited photo of the actual console and controllers taken by the seller today, ideally with a handwritten note or timestamp.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified identity/condition, and flagged as a scam risk rather than given a worst-case functional price

proof_requests: A new, un-watermarked photo of the actual console and controllers taken right now by the seller, including today's date or a handwritten note
A video of the console powering on, showing it reading a game disc
Photo of the rear panel and the serial/model sticker on the console

response.reason: The sole photo carries visible third-party watermarks ('GAME ARENA OFFICIAL', 'POSTED ON'), a strong sign this is a reused stock image rather than a photo of the seller's actual item, and none of the seller's claims (condition, origin, 10 games) are shown or verifiable from it.
